outcome: A single policy-configured dataset freshness monitor reports every dataset as fresh, stale or unknown, grouped by owner team, and serves the hotfire review check, the weekly NCR SLA report and shared reuse by forward deployed engineers.

criteria.description: Run the freshness check on engine_test_runs with fixtures whose last update is 59 minutes old, 61 minutes old, and three days old, using the 60-minute threshold read from policy configuration. Passing: the 59-minute fixture is reported fresh; the 61-minute and three-day fixtures are each reported stale; the check can be invoked on demand before a hotfire review and returns its result in a single call, so stale data is never reported fresh.

Generate the weekly NCR freshness SLA report from a fixture containing NCR datasets owned by at least two teams, with at least one dataset that has never been measured (no recorded last-update time). Passing: every row is grouped under its owner team; every dataset has exactly one status from fresh, stale or unknown; the never-measured dataset is reported with the exact status 'unknown' and is not counted as fresh in any per-team fresh count; the report lists every dataset in the fixture with none omitted.

Change a dataset's threshold only in the policy configuration file (no source code edit) and re-run the shared check. Passing: the status for a fixture dataset flips between fresh and stale according to the new threshold; a source scan of the shared capability finds no hard-coded threshold values; and the same single capability, invoked with the policy entries for engine_test_runs (60 minutes) and for an NCR table, returns correct results for both, with no per-engineer copy of the check logic required.

Validate every record emitted by the freshness monitor against the pinned, versioned record schema. Passing: 100% of records across the fresh, stale and unknown fixtures validate; each record contains dataset, owner_team, status, last_update (null when never measured), threshold and checked_at; status is exactly one of 'fresh', 'stale', 'unknown'; a record with last_update null always has status 'unknown'; and the record carries the schema version it conforms to.

needs_map.need: Know when the engine_test_runs dataset is stale using a 60-minute threshold, checked before every hotfire review, so that the dashboard does not silently show old test data.
A weekly SLA report on the freshness of NCR tables, grouped by owner team, in which any dataset never measured is reported as unknown rather than fresh.
One shared, reusable freshness-check capability to replace three hand-rolled per-engineer checks, where thresholds are policy configuration rather than code.
